title: Algorithms Fundamentals
description: Learn to think like a computer scientist: measure efficiency with Big-O, reason recursively, and master the classic sorting and searching algorithms through step-by-step interactive visualizations.

chapters.title: Getting Started
chapters.description: What algorithms are, how to measure their efficiency, and how to think recursively.

chapters.title: Sorting
chapters.description: Four classic ways to put data in order, from simple quadratic sorts to divide-and-conquer.

chapters.title: Searching
chapters.description: Find what you need fast, from scanning every item to halving the search space each step.
